response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT o.lunarstage AS lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS mean_avg FROM grp) SELECT AVG(g.avg_usage) AS avg_of_avgs, SUM(g.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(g.avg_usage - m.mean_avg) AS avg_excess FROM grp g CROSS JOIN m WHERE g.avg_usage > m.mean_avg
